description: Measurements describe chemical, physical and rheological properties of sludge during mesophilic batch digestion. Experiments vary organic substrates and inorganic additives to study effects on digestate and digestion performance. This resource is provided by Samira Miryahyaei. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The data derive from one experimental study; transfer to full-scale digesters requires justification. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
